scope: Extend generated classic standalone ATTRIB/SEQEND and POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND whole-write allocation rollback/retry/readback controls to AC1027 and AC1032.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during each test run
source.profile: One classic POLYLINE with two VERTEX children, one bulge, and SEQEND; one INSERT with two standalone non-MTEXT ATTRIB children and SEQEND. AC1027 and AC1032 ASCII and Binary are added to the existing AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021 and AC1024 version matrix.

implementation.change: Added AC1027 and AC1032 to the existing legacy compound-entity transaction version matrix. The same source-state, exact destination sentinel, stage cleanup, retry byte comparison, and typed compound-chain readback checks run for both new versions and encodings.
implementation.method: Calibrate allocation attempts for a successful complete dxfRW::write per version/encoding, inject std::bad_alloc at every reached allocation, require failure with destination and caller records unchanged and no staged file, retry the same codec, and require byte-identical output plus fresh readback of both compound entity chains and remapped identities.

validation.allocationOffsets: 526/526 injected allocation failures pass rollback/retry/typed-readback across two versions and two codecs.

limitations: Generated classic non-MTEXT compound transport/transaction evidence only; embedded-MTEXT ATTRIB, producer interoperability and native consumer behavior remain separate.
The POLYLINE profile uses two ordinary vertices and one bulge; meshes, polyfaces, widths, spline-fit variants and richer vertex XDATA profiles remain outside this slice.
AC1012 whole-write output remains refused as BAD_VERSION; no support claim is promoted.
No DWG/DXF fixture files were added.

planImpact.completedSlice: AC1027 and AC1032 ASCII/Binary whole-write allocation rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback for classic standalone attributed INSERT and classic POLYLINE compound chains.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer inventory for uncovered routes and overloads, other version-specific compound variants, and variable-size OBJECTS profiles; retain producer and semantic gates.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 182 completed slices and 35 remaining packages: 182/(182+35)=83.9%; count-based, not effort-weighted.
